query: WITH u AS (SELECT engine,n_images,mean_ms um FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path LIKE '%burst_anchor_all%' AND image_px=448 AND is_valid), l AS (SELECT engine,n_images,mean_ms lm FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path LIKE '%fn_repro%' AND image_px=448 AND is_valid) SELECT count(*),avg((lm-um)/um*100),avg(lm/um) FROM u JOIN l USING(engine,n_images);
